# 1. Data Preparation 
```{r}
data =  read.csv('metabolomics/transformed_df.csv') %>% rename(sample_id = case_number) %>% mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id))
colnames(data) <- gsub("\\.", "_", colnames(data))

compound_names = read.csv('metabolomics/compound_names.csv') %>% select(-X) %>% unique() %>% 
                 mutate(compound_id = gsub(" |-","_",compound_id),
                        compound_id = ifelse(grepl("^[0-9]", compound_id), paste0("X", compound_id), compound_id))

compound_list <- setNames(compound_names [[2]], compound_names [[1]])
```

Remove drug metabolites
```{r}
drug_metabolites <- c("Vinorelbine", "Simvastatin acid", "Acetylsalicylic acid", "Salicylic acid",
                      "Bestatin", "Trichostatin A", "Vincamine", "Castanospermine",
                      "Allopurinol", "4-Acetamidophenol", "4-Aminophenol")
drug_metabolites_to_remove <- grep(paste(drug_metabolites, collapse = "|"), compound_names$compound_name, value = T, ignore.case = F)
drug_ids_to_remove <- compound_names %>% filter(compound_name %in% drug_metabolites_to_remove) %>% pull(compound_id)
data <- data %>% select(-drug_ids_to_remove)
```

```{r}
compound_classes <- compound_names %>% filter(compound_id %in% colnames(data)) %>% count(compound_class) %>% arrange(desc(n))
```


```{r}
label_order <- c("Control", "Non-classical FAP", "Classical FAP") %>% rev()
mdata_all <- read.csv("metadata/clean/core_metadata_with_mean.csv") %>% 
         #filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver") %>% 
         mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order),
                phenotype_binary = ifelse(phenotype %in% c("Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP"), "FAP", "Control"),
                gender = ifelse(gender == "Female", 1,0))

fap_cohort_samples <- mdata_all %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver") %>% pull(sample_id)
liver_cohort_samples <- mdata_all %>% filter(phenotype_binary != "FAP") %>% pull(sample_id)
```


```{r}
sample_intersect <- intersect(data$sample_id, fap_cohort_samples)
mdata <- mdata_all %>% filter(sample_id %in% sample_intersect)
data <- data %>% filter(sample_id %in% sample_intersect)
```

```{r}
data_long <- data %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "compound_id", values_to = "val") %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id)) %>% 
  left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  left_join(compound_names, by = "compound_id") %>% filter(!is.na(phenotype))
```

```{r}

palette <- setNames(palette_df$color, palette_df$label)
```

# 2. Analysis of metabolomic data
## 2.1 PCA

```{r}
pca_result <- data %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "sample_id") %>% prcomp(center = F, scale = F)
pca_df <- pca_result$x %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PC1, PC2) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>% 
  left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id") %>% filter(!is.na(phenotype))
var_exp <- (summary(pca_result)$importance[2,][1:2] %>% unname() * 100) %>% round(.,1)
```

```{r}
wilcox_test_by_pair(pca_df, "phenotype", "PC1 ~ phenotype", FALSE) %>% add_significance()
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggp_scatter <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = phenotype, fill = phenotype)) + 
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) + 
      labs( x = paste0('Axis PC1 (',var_exp[1], '% variance explained)'),
             y = paste0('Axis PC2 (',var_exp[2], '% variance explained)'), 
            shape = "Surgery", color = "Phenotype", fill = "Phenotype") +
      scale_color_manual(values = palette) + theme_bw(base_size = 12)  + theme(legend.position = "top")
ggp_scatter

```
```{r}
ggp_density_x <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1,color = phenotype, fill = phenotype)) + 
                geom_boxplot(alpha = 0) + 
               #geom_density(alpha = 0.3) + 
               scale_fill_manual(values = palette)  + scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
```

## 2.2 Univariate analysis 
### Volcano plot
```{r}
regressors = c("age", "gender", "bmi")
metabolites <- colnames(data)[-1]
result <- data.frame()
ggdata <- data %>% left_join(mdata %>% select(sample_id,phenotype, phenotype_binary, age, gender, bmi), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(phenotype_binary = factor(phenotype_binary, levels = c("FAP", "Control")))
for (met in metabolites){
  result <- rbind(result, perm_ancova_pairs(ggdata, met, "phenotype_binary", regressors))
}
result <- result %>% mutate(p_value_adj = p.adjust(p_value_perm_pair , method = "fdr")) 
```

```{r}
volcano_data <- result %>% rename(compound_id = feature) %>% 
                left_join(compound_names, by ="compound_id") %>%  
                mutate(log_p_value = -log10(p_value_adj),
         is_enriched = (p_value_adj <  0.05 & abs(hedges_g ) > 0.5),
         enrichment_group = ifelse(hedges_g  > 0 , "Control", "FAP"), 
         enrichment_group = ifelse(is_enriched, enrichment_group, "Non-significant"),
         label = ifelse(enrichment_group == "Non-significant", "", compound_name),
         label = gsub("\\/.*", "", label))
volcano_data %>% head()
```



```{r}
p_volcano <- plot_volcano(volcano_data, y_var = "log_p_value", x_var =  "effect_size",
             color_var = "enrichment_group", label = "label",fdr_min = 0.05,
             coef_min = 0.5, n_label_overlaps = 9, label_size = 3, point_size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) + theme(legend.position = "top")+
  labs(x = "Effect size [Hedge's g]")
plot(p_volcano)

#ggsave(file="figures/f2/figure_2_volcano.svg", plot=p_volcano, width=5, height=4)
```

# 3. Data preparation for pathway enrichment analysis
```{r}
hmdb <- read.csv("metabolomics/external_data/hmdb_compound_id_to_name.tsv", sep = "\t")
hmdb_main <- hmdb %>% select(-synonyms) %>% rename(compound_name = name)
hmdb_synonyms <- hmdb %>% select(-name) %>% tidyr::separate_rows(synonyms, sep = "; ") %>% rename(compound_name = synonyms) %>% 
                 mutate(compound_name = trimws(compound_name))
```

```{r}
kegg <- read.delim("metabolomics/external_data/cmp_to_name.txt", header = FALSE,
                   col.names = c("kegg_id", "compound_name"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% 
                   tidyr::separate_rows(compound_name, sep = "; ") %>% 
                   mutate(compound_name = trimws(compound_name))
```

In order to perform pathway enrichment, the compound IDs need to be matched to KEGG compound IDs (done by name since there is no conversion key)
```{r}
greek_to_english <- c(
  "α" = "alpha", "β" = "beta", "γ" = "gamma", "δ" = "delta", "ε" = "epsilon",
  "ζ" = "zeta", "η" = "eta", "θ" = "theta", "ι" = "iota", "κ" = "kappa",
  "λ" = "lambda", "μ" = "mu", "ν" = "nu", "ξ" = "xi", "ο" = "omicron",
  "π" = "pi", "ρ" = "rho", "σ" = "sigma", "τ" = "tau", "υ" = "upsilon",
  "φ" = "phi", "χ" = "chi", "ψ" = "psi", "ω" = "omega"
)
# Split names into a single name per row (multiple naming options exist for some metabolites)
cmp <- volcano_data %>% select(compound_id, compound_name) %>% 
       tidyr::separate_rows(compound_name, sep = "/") %>% 
       mutate(compound_name = trimws(compound_name)) 
cmp$compound_name <- stringr::str_replace_all(cmp$compound_name, greek_to_english) # translate Greek letters to English 
```

```{r}
# try to match compound names to KEGG data (name to KEGG ID)
cmp <- cmp %>% left_join(kegg, by = "compound_name")
matched_compounds <- cmp %>% filter(!is.na(kegg_id)) %>% select(-compound_name) %>% unique()# 192 of the metabolites have 1 KEGG ID, 11 have multiple KEGG IDs
unmatched_compounds <- cmp %>% filter(is.na(kegg_id), !compound_id %in% matched_compounds$compound_id) %>% select(-kegg_id)

# for those that have a KEGG ID, get the HMDB ID for the main compound id or its synonyms
## Try to match to HMDB main metabolite name
cmp_main <- unmatched_compounds %>% left_join(hmdb_main, by = "compound_name") %>% filter(!is.na(accession)) # 35 metabolites matched to HMDB main names (only 18 have KEGG IDs)
matched_compounds <- rbind(matched_compounds, cmp_main %>% select(compound_id, kegg_id))
unmatched_compounds <- unmatched_compounds %>% filter(!compound_id %in% matched_compounds$compound_id)

## Try to match to HMDB synonymic metabolite names
cmp_synonyms <- unmatched_compounds %>% left_join(hmdb_synonyms, by = "compound_name") %>% filter(!is.na(accession))
matched_compounds <- rbind(matched_compounds, cmp_synonyms %>% select(compound_id, kegg_id)) # 32 metabolites matched to HMDB synonyms (only 25 have KEGG IDs)

unmatched_compounds <- unmatched_compounds %>% filter(!compound_id %in% matched_compounds$compound_id) # 56 metabolites remain without KEGG or HMDB IDs
#cat(unmatched_compounds$compound_name, sep = "\n") # these metabolites were searched using the tool metaboanalyst and results were manually validated using PubChem

manual_matches <- read.csv("metabolomics/external_data/manual_compound_search_metaboanalyst.csv") %>% 
                  left_join(cmp %>% select(compound_id, compound_name) %>% unique(), by = "compound_name")
unmatched_compounds <- manual_matches %>% filter(is.na(kegg_id)) # 38 compounds remain unmatched out of 316
                       
matched_compounds <- rbind(matched_compounds, manual_matches %>% filter(!is.na(kegg_id)) %>% select(compound_id, kegg_id) %>% unique()) %>% 
                     filter(kegg_id != "")
```

```{r}
parse_pathway_names <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  current_parent_category <- NULL
  current_category <- NULL
  result_list <- list()

  for (line in lines) {
    line <- trimws(line)
    if (line == "") {
      next  # skip empty lines and lines with single #
    }
    if (grepl("^#", line) & !grepl("^##", line)){
      current_parent_category <- sub("^#", "", line)
    }
    if (startsWith(line, "##")) {
      current_category <- sub("^##", "", line)
    } else {
      split_line <- strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]]
      if (length(split_line) == 2 && !is.null(current_category)) {
        result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          pathway_id = split_line[1],
          pathway_name = split_line[2],
          parent_category = current_parent_category,
          category = current_category,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }

  result_df <- do.call(rbind, result_list)
  return(result_df)
}

```

```{r}
volcano_data <- read.csv("figures/f2/figure_2_volcano.csv")
pathways <- read.delim("metabolomics/external_data/pathway_compound.list", header = FALSE,

            mutate(kegg_id = gsub("cpd:","", kegg_id), pathway_id = gsub("path:map","", pathway_id))

file_path = "metabolomics/external_data/pathways.list"
pathway_names <- parse_pathway_names(file_path)
pathways <- pathways %>% left_join(pathway_names, by = "pathway_id")
```

# 4. Pathway enrichment
## 4.1 Load and filter pathways
```{r}
matched_compounds <- read.csv( "processed_data/compound_id_to_ko.csv")
pathways <- read.csv("processed_data/pathways_annotated.csv")

target_pathways <- pathways %>% filter(kegg_id %in% matched_compounds$kegg_id) %>% 
                 count(pathway_id) %>% filter(n>= 3) %>% pull(pathway_id)
pathways_mid_length <- pathways %>% count(pathway_name) %>% filter(n>=10 & n <=500) %>% pull(pathway_name)

# filter irrelevant, very short and very large pathways
pathways <- pathways %>% filter(pathway_id %in% target_pathways) %>%
            filter(pathway_name %in% pathways_mid_length) #%>%
            #filter(!pathway_name %in% grep("plant", names(pathway_list), value = T))
pathway_list <- pathways %>% group_by(pathway_name) %>% summarise(compounds = list(unique(kegg_id))) 
pathway_list <- setNames(pathway_list$compounds, pathway_list$pathway_name)  
```



## 4.2 ORA - over representation analysis
```{r}
df <- volcano_data %>% left_join(matched_compounds, by =  "compound_id") %>% 
        arrange(desc(effect_size)) %>% filter(!is.na(kegg_id))

## filter compounds with multiple kegg IDs (keep one ID per metabolite)
multi_kegg_compounds <- df %>% count(compound_id) %>% filter(n>1) %>% pull(compound_id)
multi_kegg_compounds <- df %>% filter(compound_id %in% multi_kegg_compounds) %>% select(compound_id, compound_name, kegg_id)
kegg_path_count <- pathways %>% filter(kegg_id %in% multi_kegg_compounds$kegg_id) %>% count(kegg_id)
max_pathway_keggid <- multi_kegg_compounds %>% left_join(kegg_path_count, by = "kegg_id") %>% 
                        group_by(compound_id, compound_name) %>% slice(which.max(n))
keggid_to_remove <- setdiff(multi_kegg_compounds$kegg_id, max_pathway_keggid$kegg_id)
df <- df %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% keggid_to_remove)
```

```{r}
universe <- c(pathways$kegg_id, df$kegg_id) %>% unique()
fap_enriched <- run_ora_on_pathway_list(df %>% filter(enrichment_group == "FAP", p_value_adj < 0.05) %>% pull(kegg_id), pathway_list, universe) 
ctrl_enriched <- run_ora_on_pathway_list(df %>% filter(enrichment_group == "Control", p_value_adj < 0.05) %>% pull(kegg_id), pathway_list, universe)


ora_results_df <- rbind(fap_enriched %>% mutate(label = "FAP"), ctrl_enriched %>% mutate(label = "Control")) %>%
                  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
                         log10fdr = -log10(fdr),
                         log_odds_ratio = log(odds_ratio),
                         pathway = paste0(pathway, " (",n_intersect,"/",pathway_size,")"))
sig_res <- ora_results_df %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>% arrange(desc(odds_ratio))
```


```{r}
target_pathways <- sig_res %>% pull(pathway)
pathways %>% filter(pathway_name %in% target_pathways) %>% 
          select(pathway_name, pathway_id) %>% unique() %>% 
          mutate(map_id = ifelse(pathway_id < 1000, paste0("0", pathway_id), as.character(pathway_id)),
                map_id = paste0("map0",map_id)) %>% pull(map_id) %>% paste(., collapse = ", ")
```

## 4.3 Visualization
### Dotplot
```{r}
add_line_to_text <- function(text, n = 5) {
  space_pos <- gregexpr(" ", text)[[1]]
  if (length(space_pos) < n || space_pos[1] == -1) {
    return(text)
  }
  substr(text, space_pos[n], space_pos[n]) <- "\n"
  return(text)
}

sig_res$pathway_name <- sapply(sig_res$pathway, add_line_to_text)
sig_res$pathway_name <- factor(sig_res$pathway_name, levels = rev(sig_res$pathway_name))
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=10}
graph_obj <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(d = edges, vertices = nodes, directed = FALSE)
V(graph_obj)$node_size <- ifelse(V(graph_obj)$type == "pathway", 8, 3) 
V(graph_obj)$node_color <- ifelse( V(graph_obj)$type == "pathway", palette[V(graph_obj)$enrichment_group], "grey60" )

# Create the plot
pathway_graph <- ggraph(graph_obj, layout = 'fr') + 
  geom_edge_link(aes(alpha = 0.5), color = "grey",width = 0.5) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = node_size, color = node_color),shape = 16) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name,size = ifelse(type == "pathway", 4, 3),
                     fontface = ifelse(type == "pathway", "bold", "plain")), repel = TRUE,size = 3) +
  scale_size_identity() + scale_color_identity() + 
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
pathway_graph
#ggsave(file="figures/f2/figure_2_pathway_graph.svg", plot=pathway_graph, width=10, height=7)
```

## 5. Mimosa 
```{r}
mimosa_metabolomics <- data %>% left_join(mdata %>% select(patient_id, sample_id), by = "sample_id") %>% 
                       select(-sample_id) %>% 
                       tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
                       tibble::rownames_to_column("compound_id")
mimosa_metabolomics <- matched_compounds %>% left_join(mimosa_metabolomics, by = "compound_id") %>% 
                       select(-compound_id) %>% rename(KEGG = kegg_id)
```

```{r}
sample_to_patient <- mdata_all %>% filter(patient_id %in% colnames(mimosa_metabolomics)) %>% 
                     filter(batch == "Batch 22" | patient_id %in% c("4_FAP Cohort", "7_FAP Cohort")) %>% 
                     select(sample_id, patient_id)
```



```{r}
mimosa_picrust <- read.csv("qiime/combined/7_PICRUST2/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_contrib.tsv", sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
picrust_samples  <- mimosa_picrust$sample %>% unique()
picrust_samples <- gsub("tasmul-","",picrust_samples ) %>% gsub("-.*", "", .)
target_samples <- intersect(sample_to_patient$sample, picrust_samples)

mimosa_picrust_subset <- mimosa_picrust %>% filter(sample %in% target_samples) %>%
                         left_join(sample_to_patient, by = c("sample" = "sample_id")) %>% 
                         select(-sample) %>% 
                         relocate(patient_id, .before = 1) %>% rename(sample = patient_id) %>% 
                         select(1,2,3,6,5,8)

colnames(mimosa_picrust_subset) <- c("Sample", "Gene", "OTU", "GeneCountPerGenome",
                                     "OTUAbundanceInSample",	"CountContributedByOTU")
```
